## What's wrong

A clear description of the issue.

## Affected solution

- **File**: e.g. `cpp/easy/first_problem.cpp`

## Details

- [ ] Wrong answer on HackerRank
- [ ] Fails a specific test case
- [ ] Incorrect complexity in the header
- [ ] Build / CI issue

If it fails on a test case, paste the input and expected vs actual output.
